top_signals.title: Iran sets conditions for opening Strait of Hormuz after UAE says one of its ships was targeted by airstrike
top_signals.summary: Iran's military stressed that the crucial waterway would only be reopened when the U.S. accepts Iran's conditions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Military device manufacturer discloses cyber incident to SEC
top_signals.summary: IEH Corporation — which produces specialized products used in military satellites, missiles and fighter jets — said it discovered a cyberattack on Tuesday and immediately tried to contain it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
